pages.ja:
まるっきり反応がないのは気になるが、遠坂は耳栓をして寝る珍しい人種なのかもしれない。
……まああいつの事だ、俺では理解できない理由で徹夜して寝ぼけてるのかもしれないし、放っておいてもいいだろう。

pages.en:
Her complete lack of response is troubling, but perhaps Tohsaka belongs to that rare breed who sleep wearing earplugs.

…Then again, knowing her, she may have stayed up all night for some reason beyond my understanding and still be out of it. I should probably leave her alone.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I’m curious as to why there’s no reply, but Tohsaka might be one of those rare people who sleep with earplugs on.
…Well, knowing her, she might be sleeping because she stayed up late last night for unknown reasons. I guess I can let her be.

pages.ja: 「あー……そもそもだな、女の子の部屋に無断で入れるか、ばか」
pages.jaRuby: 「あー……そもそもだな、女の子の部屋に無断で入れるか、ばか」
pages.en: “Ah——I mean, come on. What kind of idiot walks into a girl's room without permission?”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Yeah…… First of all, you can’t go into a girl’s room without permission, you idiot.”

pages.ja:
カリカリと額を掻いて、禁断の扉から間合いをとる。
……なんか無駄なコトしたな。
今からでも遅くないし、商店街に行って豆腐三丁買ってこよう。

pages.en:
I scratch irritably at my forehead and put some distance between myself and the forbidden door.

…That was a waste of time.

It isn't too late. I'll go to the shopping district and buy three blocks of tofu.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I scratch my head and walk away from the forbidden door.
…That was meaningless.
It’s not too late, so I’ll go to the shopping district and buy some tofu.
